title: The analyzer does not work if SuppressSourceGeneration = true
intent: The analyzer reports its diagnostics when SuppressSourceGeneration is true, as it did in MessagePack 3.1.0.

functional.text: With SuppressSourceGeneration set to true, the analyzer still reports its diagnostics for [MessagePackObject] types.
Behaviour with SuppressSourceGeneration unset or false is the same as before.

nonFunctional.text: The restored behaviour matches MessagePack 3.1.0, the last version where the analyzer worked with this option.

derivedFrom.note: Derived by the evidence lane from the upstream issue text on 2026-11-13; not Tieto's requirements set.
